name: contaminant
description: Contaminant – dark horror laboratory tactics with simultaneous planning on a hex grid

scripts.test: npm run test -w @contaminant/engine && npm run test -w @contaminant/server
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/engine && tsc -p packages/server && tsc -p packages/client
scripts.build: npm run build -w @contaminant/client && npm run build -w @contaminant/server
scripts.desktop:dist: npm run build:client && npm run build:server && npm run dist -w @contaminant/desktop
scripts.desktop:pack: npm run build:client && npm run build:server && npm run pack -w @contaminant/desktop
scripts.smoke: npm run build:server && npm run smoke -w @contaminant/server
